limitations: Fixed development-exposed 132 questions; no independent clinical holdout.
AI-reference labels are single-judge estimates, not independent human gold.
B1-B4 use provisional documents; B5-B8 use unverified G0 graph.
Similarity scores are cosine proxies and have different text bases across pipelines.
Conditional rates exclude unavailable labels; substantive yield uses all 132 questions.
Non-substantive responses count as No in the original AI protocol; report coverage separately.
B5/B6 abstentions affect all-query latency; compare OK-only latency as well.
B1-B6 have no detector predictions, not zero detector performance.
No attribution of observed differences to PPO alone; no measured memory or energy claims.
Shell network access was disabled; sources were inspected only through the WebSearch and WebFetch tools on 2026-11-23.

WebFetch returns a model-extracted summary of a page rather than raw page text; some sources were checked from search-result snippets only. Evidence entries are therefore paraphrased findings, not verbatim excerpts.
Evidence gathering began before a context compaction in this session; verbatim text from earlier inspections was not retained, only the recorded findings and URLs.
Paywalled full texts were not accessed; journal evidence relies on abstracts/PMC pages.
Single AI judge; no inter-rater agreement and no human clinical adjudication.
The benchmark questions and the evaluation protocol were developed with exposure to the same systems' outputs, so these labels are not a blinded test-set evaluation.
Claim-type catalogue mapping is an AI judgement; equivalent claims share one verdict so errors in a catalogue entry propagate to every answer using it.
Checks establish structural consistency and original-answer alignment, not medical correctness.
Unsupported claims without evidence IDs are retained under the original AI protocol.
Missing detector predictions are never imputed; classification is agreement with AI reference.
Non-substantive responses counted as No by original protocol; separate substantive rates reported.
